title: Opulent Russian Beetroot Soup
description: A rich and light Russian beetroot soup featuring cultured crème fraîche, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot for a halal-friendly experience.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped beetroot and cook for an additional 3 minutes, letting it brown slightly.
Pour in the white wine vinegar and stir, allowing the sugars to caramelize for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock, bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pot from heat, add sugar, salt, and pepper to taste, and let the soup cool slightly.
Use an immersion blender or transfer to a countertop blender to puree the soup until smooth, then return to the pot.
Stir in the cultured crème fraîche and heat the soup gently, not boiling, for 5 minutes to meld flavors.
Ladle the soup into bowls, garnish with chopped dill, and serve hot.
Allow the soup to sit for 5 minutes before serving to thicken slightly.
